title: Small-order C6 saturation: exact values, minimum graphs, and a correction

contribution.claim: Exact C6 saturation values 14,16,17,19,20 at orders 11--15, with complete minimum families of 1,35,4,205,24 isomorphism classes.
contribution.new_in_v6: Complete 24-class order-15 minimum family: 12 leaf-containing and 12 leaf-free classes, corroborated by a weighted-kernel route.
contribution.scope: Written mathematical arguments and complete finite computation with independent property implementations; no general bound improvement.
contribution.correction: The order-11 14-edge witness contradicts the reported value 15 in Remark 1, page 1089, of Zhang--Luo--Shigeno (2015); its general theorem is unaffected.

source.deposit_tracker_access: private; public HoG records and the scoped archive carry the public evidence

evidence.lower_bound_scope: No saturated graph through 19 edges, previously published in v5.
evidence.weighted_kernel_route: Independent candidate-generation method recovers all 92/12 leaf-free classes at orders 14/15; complete assignment domains are checked.

attribution.Zhang_Luo_Shigeno: Prior exact values and complete families at orders 9/10; known order-12 value; prior leaf/core methods.
attribution.Lan_Shi_Wang_Zhang: Prior matching upper-bound constructions at orders 12--15, DOI 10.1016/j.disc.2025.114504.
attribution.software: nauty/geng, pynauty, NetworkX, Python, C++ toolchains, PySAT and verification tools retain specific credit.
attribution.ai_assistance: Substantial Claude and OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, checking and writing.

public_disclosures.scope: Order-11 correction, order-12/13 classifications and exactness through order 14.
205-class order-14 family and order-15 exactness; order-15 family not classified in this version.
Complete 24-class order-15 family and supporting completed structural evidence. Historical computation dates are not public-disclosure dates.

limitations: No human peer-review or proof-assistant verification claim.
Unrestricted completeness trusts geng's isomorph-free generation and partition contract; equal totals alone do not prove coverage.
The weighted-kernel coverage proof is written mathematics, and the full multigraph catalog lacks a second generator implementation.
Minimum status uses separate lower-bound evidence; fixed-edge classification alone is insufficient.
The later prefix-compression pilot is sampled and negative for its tested representation.
Bounded literature searches do not establish global novelty or priority.
